function.description: For Managed AP location count queries, always return the requested category counts and an explicit combined total. For "primary and secondary" queries, return Primary count, Secondary count, and Total (Primary+Secondary). Include Anchor count only when explicitly requested or when the query is for all managed location count categories. For runtime managed-site count controller/WLC queries, if hostname/IP/serial is provided instead of networkDeviceId, resolve the controller first with get_device_details and pass the returned canonical networkDeviceId. For controller serial-number managed-site count-style queries, do not use api_getPnP*
function.name: api_getManagedAPLocationsCountForSpecificWirelessController

networkDeviceId.description: Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET: /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.

anchorManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Anchor managed ap  locations.

primaryManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Primary managed ap locations.

secondaryManagedApLocationsCount.description: The count of the Secondary managed ap locations.
